title: Room on one side can be a knob
goal: A card with 16 points of room at the sides and 10 at the top and bottom cannot offer its room to copies at all today, because a knob has to show one number and there is no single number there. This lets one side be offered on its own, so a copy can be given more room at the top without touching the other three.
notes: ComponentNumberSlot.padding reads GroupLayout.usedPadding.uniform and returns nil when the sides disagree, so the slot is simply not offered. A per-side knob means either widening ComponentNumberSlot with four side cases or giving the slot a GroupPadding.Side. Watch the Add menu size: four extra rows per group is exactly the bloat the kind-grouped menu exists to stop, so only offer sides where they already disagree.
acceptance: Room on one named side of a group can be offered as a knob
A copy shows it as a number field, and the other three sides stay the original's
A group whose four sides already agree still offers the single Padding knob it offers today, not four extra rows
Tests in PhotonzCore cover it before the app code is written
